entries.heading: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any funds
ancestors: DIVISION L—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2018
entries.text:
Sec. 161.  Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any funds 
appropriated before October 1, 2017, under any section of chapter 53 of 
title 49, United States Code, that remain available for expenditure, may 
be transferred to and administered under the most recent appropriation 
heading for any such section.
